easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show guitar-theory worksheet exam figure of the standard open-position chord box for a named guitar chord, black-on-white straight-on? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.
